description: ETH spot price in USD, read on-chain from the two deepest WETH/USDC Uniswap V3 pools, on Ethereum and on Base. Returns their median plus each pool's own price, so a caller can see the spread between chains. Computed from chain state; no exchange feed. Costs 0.001 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
